Currently scheduled for launch Feb 18th, at 10:01 EST / 15:01 UTC from LC-39A. This is the first launch from LC-39A since the last shuttle mission from that pad, STS-135, July 8, 2011, thus it is also the first SpaceX launch from the pad since their rebuild/modification of it. After reaching orbit, Dragon will maneuver its way to the ISS, rendezvous, and then dock. It will remained docked for 4 weeks, then undock, deorbit, and splashdown in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of Baja California. First stage recovery will be Return to Landing Site (RTLS).
